name: sajag-bharat
description: Sajag Bharat — Hindi news portal. Static HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Cloudflare Pages Functions backend, GitHub as the content + image store.

scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 execute sajag-bharat-db --local --file=db/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sajag-bharat-db --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute sajag-bharat-db --remote --file=db/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute sajag-bharat-db --remote --file=db/seed.sql
